title: nerv credentials list: name, place, last rotation; never a value
goal: One command lists every credential NERV holds with where it lives and when it was last rotated
acceptance: A test shows every configured credential kind listed and no value, prefix or hash printed
Rotation through the existing commands updates the date
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: read existing rotation paths, add a date and a list. Not a measurement.
